name: empty-content-ux-messages
details:
Improve UX messaging for empty content scenarios in memory operations.

Three improvements needed:
1. view command with empty file → "Memory file is empty."
2. view command with empty directory → "Directory is empty." (both simple and tree modes)
3. create command without file_text → "Created empty memory file."

Implementation locations:
- src/memory/operations.ts (viewFile, viewDirectory, create functions)
- src/memory/tree-view.ts (renderDirectoryTree function)

After implementation: comprehensive testing with both tool modes

tasks.name: Implement empty file message
tasks.details:
Modify viewFile function in operations.ts (line 190-236):
- After reading content, check if content === ''
- Return 'Memory file is empty.' immediately
- Avoids showing '1: ' for empty files

tasks.name: Implement empty directory message (simple mode)
tasks.details:
Modify viewDirectory function in operations.ts (line 153-185):
- After building items array (line 181), check if items.length === 0
- Return 'Directory is empty.' instead of formatted output
- Only applies to simple mode (non-tree-view)

tasks.name: Implement empty directory message (tree mode)
tasks.details:
Modify renderDirectoryTree function in tree-view.ts (line 269-282):
- After building tree (line 278), check if tree.length === 0
- Return 'Directory is empty.' instead of header + empty content
- Applies when tree view is enabled

tasks.name: Implement empty file creation message
tasks.details:
Modify create function in operations.ts (line 245-276):
- Check if file_text is undefined or empty string
- Return 'Created empty memory file.' for empty files
- Return 'File created successfully at {path}' for non-empty files

tasks.name: Test empty file view
tasks.details:
Test with both tool modes:
- Create empty file, then view it
- Verify message: 'Memory file is empty.'
- Test with both unified and separate tool modes

tasks.name: Test empty directory view
tasks.details:
Test with both tool modes and both view modes:
- Create empty directory, then view it (simple mode)
- View empty directory with tree view enabled
- Verify message: 'Directory is empty.' in both cases
- Test with both unified and separate tool modes

tasks.name: Test empty file creation
tasks.details:
Test create command without file_text:
- Call create without file_text parameter
- Verify message: 'Created empty memory file.'
- Call create with non-empty file_text
- Verify message: 'File created successfully at {path}'
- Test with both unified and separate tool modes

tasks.name: Update README examples
tasks.details:
Update README.md to reflect new messages:
- Update view command examples for empty files/directories
- Update create command example for empty file creation
- Ensure examples are accurate and helpful
